Assam's ancient history and its links to epics discussed

Dr. Sauradeep Nath discussed the potential links between Assam's ancient history and the epics Ramayana and Mahabharata. The discussion gained traction amidst the release of Nitesh Tiwari's film. Nath's explanations were featured on the platform 'Ranveer'. The conversation explored historical connections to ancient Indian narratives.
